text:
ana: Kicking off onboarding for the new GPU region (ap-south3). Need cloud account/project + VNet scaffold checklist so infra can provision reserved capacity next week. :wave:
sahil: cheers — can you paste the target org/account IDs and whether this is Dedicated or Private?
ana: it's Dedicated for now — account: proj-redwood-ap3 (org 987654321).
maria: quick flags: ap-south3 has limited A100 availability in some zones. we'll need fallback SKUs (A10G / T4) and a policy to route to eu-west1 if quota fails.
lee: +1 on fallback. Also need explicit CIDR carve for tenant subnets and egress NAT gateway plan. Prefer /20 for cluster pools.
nana: draft CIDR proposal: 10.100.0.0/16 for region, with /20 for gpu-pool (10.100.0.0/20), /24 for mgmt (10.100.16.0/24), /24 for prometheus (10.100.17.0/24). Any objections?
sahil: works. confirm whether we need private-google-access or equivalent for cloud-agent telemetry. Private-only path required for Private deployments but Dedicated can be customer-managed.
maria: We'll enable Private Google Access and service endpoints for storage. Also enable restricted API access and log sinks to central logging project.
josh: Cost note — A100 capacity reserved will add ~+$55k/mo baseline. If we use mixed SKUs with auto-fallback we can cap spend during pull-forward tests.
nana: Understood. Need quota requests. Maria, can you run the quota template with expected GPUs: 8xA100, fallback 24xT4?
maria: Yep — filing request now. Template snippet below:
```
Quota request:
project: proj-redwood-ap3
region: ap-south3
GPUs:
 - A100: 8
 - T4: 24
Requested date: 2026-04-03
Justification: Dedicated cluster for inference, latency-sensitive workloads, reserve for pilot customers.
```
lee: Networking prerequisites: share route table with edge transit project, add NSG rules: allow 6443 from controlplane, 22 from bastion subnet, ephemeral ports for workers to internet via NAT, and 179 for BGP peering if using metal transit.
sahil: Who's owning IAM? Need a service account (infra-provisioner@proj-redwood-ap3) with roles: compute.admin, network.admin, serviceusage.admin, iam.serviceAccountUser. Also KMS perms if customer wants encrypted volumes.
josh: Add budget alert: set forecast threshold at 60% and push to #finance-alerts. Keep tag key=env:value=dedicated-ap3.
nana: For bootstrap we plan: 1) Terraform scaffold apply (vpc, subnets, firewall, route table) 2) Quota & SKU confirmation 3) Reserved instance order 4) Cluster engine bootstrap (runtime images, quantized kernels) 5) Smoke tests + perf profile.
maria: Smoke tests to run (quick list): curl /health on model router, sample gen (token count 64) 100 requests at concurrency 8, KV cache warmup test, embeddings test. Use the runbook command:
```bash
# run basic perf test
./infra/perf/run_local.sh --region ap-south3 --concurrency 8 --tokens 64
```
lee: Add network validation commands:
```
# verify subnet routes
gcloud compute routes list --filter="network=projects/proj-redwood-ap3/global/networks/default"
# check firewall
gcloud compute firewall-rules list --filter="network=proj-redwood-ap3/default"
```
ana: Can infra run the terraform apply on Thursday? I can pair for handoff to Solutions on Friday for customer-facing docs.
infra-bot: Scheduled: terraform apply job queued for 2026-04-07T10:00Z (assignee: sahil). See run id: tf-apply-20260407-42.
sahil: I'll take the apply. Will add a step to snapshot route table before changes.
josh: Also coordinate capacity placement window with procurement for GPU reservation (they need 72h notice).
maria: Quota request approved (email landed). A100 quota granted but only in zone ap-south3-a for now. We'll plan canary in -a then scale to -b if capacity frees up.
lee: Handoff checklist for Solutions (short): account IDs, VPC/CIDRs, firewall list, IAM service account, KMS key id, GPU SKU map, canary zones, smoke test results, monitoring dashboards + alerts.
ana: I'll assemble docs into a single Google doc and ping Solutions. Who wants to own rollback playbook if the region health regresses?
sahil: I can own rollback playbook. Steps: drain nodes, shift traffic to eu-west1, disable autoscale in ap-south3, release reserved GPUs.
ana: Perfect. Final ask: please add perf baseline numbers to the runbook after smoke tests. If  p99 latency > 300ms we hold.
josh: noted. tagging @maria for perf baseline capture. :eyes: 
maria: Will post results in thread after tests.
ana: Thanks team — target handoff Friday 2026-04-09. :tada:
infra-bot: Thread archived to eng-infra on 2026-04-09T18:00Z.
